title: Role Resolution and Inheritance Map

superseded_ids.reason: Project-scoped dedicated definition supersedes the earlier scaffold identifier.
Project-scoped governed definition replaces the earlier generic scaffold identifier.

delivery_approval_separation.boundary: These TIVERIT/project roles do not by themselves establish ISO 19650 task-team, lead-appointed-party or appointing-party functions.

iso_19650_project_function_mapping.rule: When ISO 19650 is applicable, ISO party and team functions remain canonical. A TIVERIT or project job title may perform an ISO function only when the appointment, BEP, RACI or equivalent governing project instrument establishes that mapping; otherwise the mapping is authority_unresolved.

relevant_activities: submit information model for lead appointed party authorization
submit information model for appointing party acceptance
review and accept or reject information model

prohibited_inference: Project BIM Manager equals lead appointed party
Discipline Lead equals task team approval authority for every project
Client Representative equals appointing party acceptance authority
CDE Manager or platform administrator gains ISO decision authority from technical permissions

pre_publish_gate.boundary: TIVERIT pre-publish governance is supplementary and shall not replace applicable ISO approval-for-sharing, authorization or acceptance activities.

curator_note: ISO-IMP-005 role-mapping pass: ISO 19650 functions are not replaced by enterprise job titles. Project-specific mapping is required and missing mapping remains unresolved.
